name: Barbell Upright Row
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold a barbell in front of your thighs with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Brace your core and keep your chest upright.
Pull the bar straight upward close to your torso by leading with your elbows out and up toward shoulder level.
Lower the bar smoothly back down to your thighs under full control.
tips: Stop pulling once your elbows reach shoulder height or slightly below to keep your shoulders comfortable.
Keep your wrists straight below your elbows and avoid leaning back for momentum.
